global: A bowl of shoyu ramen features a clear, amber broth with thin noodles and bean sprouts atop. Served in a blue-patterned ceramic bowl, it rests on a dark wooden surface under soft, even lighting.

regions.background: Dark brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, forming an oval-shaped surface beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue geometric and cloud patterns, smooth glossy surface, rounded rim.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, bean sprouts, and minced meat, golden-brown, clear, and glossy surface.
